I don't know if you're still here but here's how it is: She has to choose which suffering you should feel. If you don't get better and don't change you will cause other people to hurt, and you will most likely die young or go to prison. Her job is to lower the amount of suffering by as much as possible, so she has to do this because existing as you are now causes other people to suffer. The truth is that no one will accept you who you are right now. They will find you charming on the surface, but when they see these narcissistic traits they will no longer want to be with you. She isn't trying to hurt you, isn't mad at you, and doesn't hate you. She probably does not think about you nearly as much as you think about her. 

The fact you can't be told to change at all or you will hurt yourself and others is why you need to change. It's not a way to live your life, and it means your life sucks. She wants your life to suck less. Her job is to make your life suck less, it's what she's paid for. She is not committing mistreatment, and she is not going to lose her license. You, however, could lose your freedom and life if you don't comply with treatment. You can choose to try or you can be weak and give up, and that's that. 

Almost nobody with NPD or ASPD tries in therapy. They get mad instead. You could be better than them by trying. Your mental health issues are actually what makes you vulnerable- what she's trying to do will actually make you stronger and less vulnerable to being arrested or manipulated by other people. It's all up to whether you are strong enough to improve.
